features.title: Trellis Engineering project structure
definition_of_done: AGENTS.md and .trellis/spec/fluxpost define the active workflow and project facts
The deterministic baseline checks Trellis structure without external production calls
evidence: 2026-08-26 Trellis task state, current facts, context budgets, and baseline contracts were reconciled; detailed history remains under .trellis/spec/fluxpost/archive/.
features.notes: Trellis is the only active persistent AI collaboration system.

features.title: Keyword crawl and content pool
definition_of_done: Users can crawl supported platforms or import supported links into the owner-scoped content pool
Retained items expose normalized metrics, media, timestamps, and frozen safety assessment
evidence: Keyword/link import, content safety, persistence, platform mapping, and Dongchedi focused checks are in the offline baseline.
features.notes: Live provider/model behavior remains pending operator approval.

features.title: Crawled media cache, video frames, and video transcription
definition_of_done: Crawled media can be cached and downloaded videos can produce policy-selected frames
Optional transcription can merge speech text before rewrite with visible failures
evidence: Media download, frame, quality, original-reference, and transcription checks pass offline.
features.notes: Live Ark transcription remains outside the default baseline.

features.title: Batch content production
definition_of_done: Selected sources create independent production tasks and reviewable drafts
Drafts preserve title, body, image choices, and review status
evidence: Production routes, persistence, concurrency, generation, and review contracts are covered by the baseline.
features.notes: Live text/image provider behavior remains pending operator review.

features.title: Review and Feishu publishing
definition_of_done: Users can edit, approve, and queue generated posts for Feishu
Durable publish jobs preserve mode, chunks, records, attachments, retry, and ownership
evidence: 2026-08-18 full/text/media UI, API, queue, CLI, Canvas, compatibility, and responsive checks passed without live writes.
features.notes: A real operator-approved Base publish with final media is still required.

features.title: Feishu distribution audit write-back
definition_of_done: Signed-in users can queue record audits with independent distribution decisions and scores
Results write to the configured Feishu fields through isolated durable workers
evidence: Distribution API, queue, prompt, persistence, concurrency, and UI checks pass without live Feishu writes.
features.notes: A small intentional live validation with real record numbers remains.

features.title: Execution activity log
definition_of_done: Backend operations append owner-scoped activity entries without whole-table replacement
Users can read and clear permitted activity
evidence: Execution-log append, compaction, ownership, and API contracts pass in the baseline.
features.notes: Legacy JSON remains only as a migration artifact.

features.title: SQLite runtime persistence
definition_of_done: SQLite is the fallback runtime store and legacy JSON can migrate without deletion
The baseline verifies schema and active stores
evidence: Database, migration, content, post, queue, and workspace-store checks pass against isolated SQLite.
features.notes: PostgreSQL is the configured local runtime; SQLite remains the supported fallback.

features.title: PostgreSQL runtime storage and migration
definition_of_done: DATABASE_URL selects PostgreSQL while its absence keeps SQLite fallback
Schema and SQLite-to-PostgreSQL migration cover active runtime domains without moving media
evidence: 2026-06-04 local PostgreSQL provisioning and migration passed; the offline schema check remains in the baseline.
features.notes: Future high-volume queue redesign is separate scope.

features.title: One-command Ubuntu VPS deployment
definition_of_done: Bootstrap, exact-SHA verification/deploy, rollback, volumes, image retention, and weekly cache cleanup are deterministic
Production 38 remains healthy behind host Nginx without changing unrelated services
evidence: 2026-08-06 production retention kept current plus two rescues, reclaimed about 17 GB, preserved services/volumes, and enabled weekly prune.
features.notes: Repository Caddy bootstrap remains unverified on the Nginx-managed production host.

features.title: Content and TOS-backed image resource workspaces
definition_of_done: Content, review, and authenticated TOS-backed image libraries are separate operational workspaces
The retired local-path material domain is absent from active UI, APIs, schema, and migration
evidence: 2026-07-29 legacy material removal plus content/library ownership, sorting, selection, build, and browser checks passed.
features.notes: External provider calls remain excluded from default verification.

features.title: AI auto-tagging for crawled content and visual assets
definition_of_done: Sources receive allowed content tags and available visuals receive allowed visual tags
Manual edits persist without blocking text tags on visual-model failure
evidence: Source tagging, image filtering, frame-first selection, persistence, and safety checks pass offline.
features.notes: Live vision/text model quality remains pending review.

features.title: Batch management for content pool and generated posts
definition_of_done: Users can select and batch-update or confirm-delete content and posts
Mutations preserve ownership, persistence, activity logging, and refreshed UI state
evidence: Content desk, generated-post persistence, permissions, and responsive selection checks pass.
features.notes: Manual review remains advisable before destructive high-volume use.

features.title: V1 whitelist account system with owner isolation
definition_of_done: Whitelist accounts use hashed passwords, HttpOnly sessions, and stable owner identities
Members see their records while admins retain workspace-wide access
evidence: Account schema, session, role, ownership, API authorization, build, and baseline checks pass without real credentials.
features.notes: Direct authorization of guessed media URLs remains a later hardening item.

features.title: High-throughput provider concurrency
definition_of_done: Provider and worker domains use bounded shared pools with serialized status writes where required
Row-level writes and durable queues prevent lost concurrent updates
evidence: Concurrency, queue, generated-post upsert, execution-log, and scheduler checks pass offline.
features.notes: Large live runs and subtask-level replay remain pending product validation.

features.title: Compact automatic content workflow
definition_of_done: Signed-in users run supported keyword, link, Dongchedi, Feishu, viral, or original inputs from the compact workspace
Durable runs preserve settings, progress, pause/resume/termination, review staging, and optional Feishu behavior
evidence: Simple-mode input, queue, persistence, configuration, media, Dongchedi, review, and responsive checks pass offline.
features.notes: Live authorized providers and authenticated operator walkthrough remain.

features.title: Reference and vehicle image library
definition_of_done: Signed-in users import, tag, sort, select, preview, share, and delete permitted TOS-backed assets
Reference AI tags and manual vehicle tags preserve distinct contracts and ownership
evidence: Library schema/API/auth/tag/theme/sort/cursor/selection/migration/browser checks and production route health passed.
features.notes: Real production-38 TOS and GPT tag/retry samples remain; retired 104 is not a gate.

features.title: Volcengine TOS runtime media storage
definition_of_done: New runtime media can persist verified public TOS URLs behind a default-off switch
Failures retain recoverable bytes; historical local URLs and file-only consumers remain compatible
evidence: Offline producer/consumer checks and an isolated PUT/HEAD/public GET/Range/delete probe passed.
features.notes: A real production-38 application image/video workflow remains; retired 82/104 are out of scope.

features.title: Infinite canvas workflow V1
definition_of_done: Owner-scoped typed DAG workflows persist drafts, immutable runs, retries, cancellation, media, and review artifacts
V2 schedulers freeze inputs and support batch expansion, shared outputs, aggregation, Excel hierarchies, and portable workflows
Default checks cover graph, API, persistence, providers, media, subtitles, scheduler, desktop, and mobile contracts without live writes
evidence: 2026-08-25 Excel readiness/history, generic aggregation, review isolation, retries, build, smoke, full baseline, and responsive Canvas checks passed.
features.notes: Live provider/Feishu runs and multi-user PostgreSQL concurrency remain.

features.title: Owner-scoped copy library and batch rewriting
definition_of_done: Users manage owner-scoped copy entries with search, tags, sharing, sorting, selection, and permissions
Canvas and schedulers freeze copy snapshots and support no-replacement conditional assignment
evidence: Copy persistence, permissions, sorting, snapshots, scheduling, build, and responsive checks pass without providers.
features.notes: Authenticated multi-user use and a real two-call text batch remain.

features.title: Local and remote production code parity
definition_of_done: Port 3001 runs one clean committed candidate with full-SHA identity and rollback-safe build slots
Final parity requires local HEAD/runtime, origin/main, and production to share the exact SHA
evidence: 2026-08-20 primary-worktree A/B activation, failure restoration, full baseline, and candidate identity passed.
features.notes: Runtime data and configuration remain intentionally environment-specific.

features.title: Batch original Xiaohongshu card workspace
definition_of_done: Signed-in operators manage 1-100 topic batches with durable two-stage copy, anchored cards, QA, retry, pause/resume, and review metadata
PostgreSQL/SQLite queues and GeneratedPost projections remain review/Feishu compatible
evidence: Original batch schema/API/orchestration/recovery/build/browser checks and production route/schema health passed.
features.notes: A real small provider batch and authenticated multi-user lifecycle remain.
